covers: Shared-exporter verification for MST-W1-23 (fixer muse-b6, branch v1/bugs; author of record muse-b9 per CB-0828 — content supplied by the fixer, registration and activation are the author's and reviewer's). The export-file shape replays per lens surface: the walker opens each of the ticket's lenses (ethics, neuro, dtus, message, physics, suffering, bio, urban-planning) plus /hub, clicks the export control, and requires the export response (GET /api/lens/<domain>/export) at 200 carrying the signed-in account's own seeded content — never an empty or missing file, never another account's rows; an account with no content gets the honest empty state (route 404, 'Nothing to export yet'), never a file. Full numbered checks, endpoint shapes, and the read-back persistence check live in RECIPE-MST-W1-23.md in the shared quality folder. Post-fix at the seat: commits 5177b5b29 (dtus library gather + neuro wiring) and 2671d7158 (hub actor-scoped provider), gate suites pass fixed / fail pristine. Control names are code-derived ('Export Data' from DTUExportButton / the toolbar ExportMenu); captured names from the W0 packet supersede at re-capture — hub is a sample lens, so if hub is re-captured its leg re-premises on the re-captured packet (founder correction #4).
discriminator: Replayed at the fixer seat against the pre-fix build f4f1f77ff (2026-11-17), verdict FAIL on all three legs: (1) dtus — caller owns 3 DTUs (meta.lens physics / music / untagged); collectLensExport('dtus') -> total 0 artifacts [] sources {stateRecords: 0, dtus: 0} (real mints tag their origin lens in meta.lens, never 'dtus', so the domain-filtered gather was structurally empty). (2) neuro — export returned the realtime feed object {source: 'live-eeg', samples: [0.12, -0.34], note: 'the realtime feed, not user content'}; the account's recording absent (page handed data={realtimeData} to DTUExportButton). (3) hub — collectLensExport('hub') -> total 0 for caller, stranger, and anonymous alike with 2 caller-acted events in STATE.hubActivity (no export provider registered for the hub domain).
